brief.scope: Independently review C2 task output semantics against the owning contracts, frozen reviewed tests and producer record. Read current AGENTS.md and ops/README.md. Scope is envelope.py/outputs.py only; verify no frozen test/catalogue edits and compare all five supplied test hashes. Run test_job_outputs*.py and the full task suite where allowed. Check native declarations versus strict JSON decoding, closed shape, paths/reservations/collisions, exact rendering/handles, optional commit transport, legacy preservation and the narrow inline exception. Catalogue activation must remain deferred to canonical launcher consumption. Do not edit code/tests or create runtime authority. Return exact refs, approve/changes, findings, measured commands and limits in the inline envelope. This is library acceptance, not launch/live-capability approval.

findings.claim: Optional commit transport is reconciled only in envelope.validate. CONTRACT.md:129-135 names later reconciliation of the optional write-job commit member with the validator's fixed fields and points at run.py:297-335. envelope.py:434 now filters commit out of the key-order check so validate accepts the member ENVELOPE_SCHEMA has advertised since 710dbac (blob 1451eefc line 100). run.py:298 and run.py:306 still recognize an envelope only when tuple(value)==envelope.FIELDS. Measured: envelope.build plus commit validates; run._candidate_envelope and run._parse_envelope return None for that dict, its JSON text, and the same dict nested under result; the envelope without commit is found. Not a regression: both seams refused commit at 710dbac. envelope.py was the producer's only permitted file. This is the unpaid half of the named reconciliation and must be discharged before launch claims commit transport end to end.

The catalogue seam cannot carry transport reservations. CONTRACT.md:343-346: launch supplies adapter/launcher transport reservations to validation; equal, ancestor or descendant collisions refuse. validate_outputs and load_outputs take reserved=; outputs_from_job(spec) calls validate_outputs(spec.get("outputs", _OMITTED)) with no reserved passthrough, and render_declared_outputs/append_declared_outputs have no reserved parameter. Measured: [{"kind":"file","path":"adapter-state.json","artifact":"state"}] refuses through validate_outputs(..., reserved=("adapter-state.json",)) and is admitted unchanged through outputs_from_job on a job spec carrying the same array; render_declared_outputs also emits it. Reachable only at adoption; nothing calls these seams yet.

Duplicate JSON object members are refused only on the text seam. CONTRACT.md:332-333: Task's semantic declaration validation additionally rejects duplicate JSON object members. That check lives in load_outputs' object_pairs hook. A catalogue decoded with ordinary json.loads has already collapsed the repeated member; outputs_from_job then sees valid native data. Measured: load_outputs refuses [{"kind":"file","path":"A.md","artifact":"a","path":"B.md"}]; the same array reached through json.loads of a catalogue fragment is admitted as the collapsed last member, path B.md. Frozen tests put this duty on the text seam, so this is not a departure from the tests; adoption must re-encode outputs through load_outputs or add a catalogue-level strict decode.

One of the three C2 refusal classes is not an OutputsError. envelope.py:122 introduces OutputsError as a declaration or bound output path that cannot satisfy C2; dispatch/CONTRACT.md:294-303 names outputs-schema, outputs-path and outputs-handle as C2 refusal ids. _outputs_refuse raises OutputsError for outputs-schema and outputs-path; the handle mismatch at envelope.py:507 raises a bare EnvelopeError with an outputs-handle: prefix. Measured: schema and path refusals are OutputsError; the handle refusal is EnvelopeError that is not OutputsError. Frozen tests assert the base EnvelopeError; a consumer that catches OutputsError to classify C2 refusals misses the handle class.

Against the contract. Native vs strict JSON: outputs_from_job reads only an explicit outputs member, missing key is [], explicit null refuses, prompt prose and job name are not searched; validate_outputs has no job parameter. load_outputs uses object_pairs to refuse duplicate members before dict collapse and parse_constant to refuse NaN/Infinity. Closed shape: exact member sets per kind. Grammar: re.fullmatch, so a trailing newline cannot pass. Paths/reservations/collisions: _overlaps is segment-wise; reserved is unioned with TRANSPORT_RESERVED so a supplied list can only tighten; reserved entries are grammar-checked. Rendering: check-tests example is exact at /jobs/example/out; json.dumps(ensure_ascii=True) lowercase hex, no optional slash escaping; declaration order is visit order; omission and [] render the none-grant line; an unrepresentable bound path refuses outputs-path before emit. Exact handles: decoded string equality. Legacy: validate(env) with no outputs keyword leaves historical relative and non-canonical handles valid; out_root is reached only when a row exists. Narrow inline exception: inline_planning_exception is True and job=='plan', and in the outputs loop additionally artifact 'plan' at path PLAN.md; not an outputs kind; does not reach skeptic or ruling.

The P2 is the named later reconciliation stopping at the module boundary. Frozen independently reviewed tests (Grok-authored, Opus-approved at 43cd8b5) remain red-to-green evidence at 99/99 and 312/312. Freeze readiness: yes for the library.
